name: SNOMED CT Terminology
description:
SNOMED CT is the world's most comprehensive clinical terminology, used in electronic health records across more than 80 countries. This connector gives Claude direct access to it through SNOMED International's terminology server.

Use it to look up concepts by code or name, validate that a code exists and is active, test subsumption between concepts, navigate the hierarchy (ancestors, children, descendants), and expand value sets using Expression Constraint Language (ECL). It works across all SNOMED CT editions available on the connected backend, including the International, US and Australian editions.

Every tool is read-only, the connector never modifies terminology data. It runs as a stateless proxy to the configured Snowstorm instance, holding no query content or personal data between requests.

Built and maintained by SNOMED International, the owners of SNOMED CT.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SNOMED CT Terminology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SNOMED CT Terminology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://snowstorm-mcp.snomedtools.org/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is SNOMED CT Terminology MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, SNOMED CT Terminology scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SNOMED CT Terminology MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SNOMED CT Terminology lists 15 MCP tools, including fhir_metadata, list_terminologies, server_capabilities, server_health, snomed_expand, snomed_get_ancestors, snomed_get_children, snomed_get_descendants, snomed_lookup, snomed_subsumes, snomed_validate_code, and snowstorm_get_concept_native.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SNOMED CT Terminology?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SNOMED CT Terminology in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, Amass Connector, and BioSkepsis.

_published_faq.name: Does SNOMED CT Terminology MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SNOMED CT Terminology does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
SNOMED CT Terminology is developed by SNOMED International. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
